records.jp: ねえ、愛央。<CR>あなたはこの世界に来て、何か変わった？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao. Do you feel like you've changed since coming to this world?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao. Do you feel like you've changed since coming to this world?
records.en: Hey, Ao.<CR>Do you feel like you've changed since coming to this world?

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 目に見えた変化はないかもしれないけど、<CR>「意識」は変わったかもしれないな
records.en_original: I'm not sure I've changed on the outside, but the way I see things I think has changed.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure I've changed on the outside, but the way I see things I think has changed.
records.en: There may not be any visible change,<CR>but my mindset may have changed.

records.jp: 意識？
records.en_original: The way you see things?
records.en_auxiliary: The way you see things?
records.en: Your mindset?

records.jp: うん。私……なんにも持ってない自分が嫌いで、<CR>何かが欲しい、何かになりたいってずっと思ってた
records.en_original: Yeah. I always hated myself for having nothing. I always wanted to be someone.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I always hated myself for having nothing. I always wanted to be someone.
records.en: I hated myself for having nothing,<CR>and always wanted something—wanted to become something.

records.jp: 結局、自分自身はそう簡単に変わらなかった。<CR>私はいつまでも星崎愛央のまま
records.en_original: In the end, I wasn't able to change myself so easily. I will always be Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: In the end, I wasn't able to change myself so easily. I will always be Ao Hoshizaki.
records.en: In the end, I didn't change so easily.<CR>I'll always be Hoshizaki Ao.

records.jp: でも、それでいいのかもなーって思った。<CR>きっとこれが私らしさなんだろうし
records.en_original: But I've learned to be okay with that. I am who I am.
records.en_auxiliary: But I've learned to be okay with that. I am who I am.
records.en: But maybe that's okay.<CR>This is probably what makes me who I am.

records.jp: そうね……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: あなたは目に見えた変化はないって言うけど、<CR>後ろから見てると意外と分かるものよ？
records.en_original: You say you haven't changed on the outside, but you'd be surprised what you can see from another perspective.
records.en_auxiliary: You say you haven't changed on the outside, but you'd be surprised what you can see from another perspective.
records.en: You say there aren't any visible changes,<CR>but from where I'm standing, they're surprisingly easy to see.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 言葉の一つ一つや立ち振る舞い、<CR>そういうところからも、意識の変化は見てとれる
records.en_original: I can see the change in the way you speak, how you behave.
records.en_auxiliary: I can see the change in the way you speak, how you behave.
records.en: The change in your mindset shows<CR>in every word and gesture.

records.jp: 愛央、あなたは変わったわ。<CR>以前と比べれば、少しだけたくましくなった
records.en_original: You've changed, Ao. You're a little tougher than you used to be.
records.en_auxiliary: You've changed, Ao. You're a little tougher than you used to be.
records.en: You've changed, Ao.<CR>You're a little tougher than you used to be.

records.jp: 少しだけ？
records.en_original: Just a little?
records.en_auxiliary: Just a little?
records.en: Just a little?

records.jp: ええ、少しだけね
records.en_original: Yes. Just a little.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Just a little.
records.en: Yes. Just a little.

records.jp: そっか～。少しか～
records.en_original: Aww... Just a little, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Aww... Just a little, huh...
records.en: Aww... Just a little, huh...

records.jp: ……雫世界で、私たちはいろんなことを経験した。<CR>私たちはその思い出を、忘れてしまうかもしれない
records.en_original: We experienced many things in the Oasis... Things we may forget.
records.en_auxiliary: We experienced many things in the Oasis... Things we may forget.
records.en: In Oasis, we experienced all sorts of things.<CR>We may forget those memories.

records.jp: ……けど、次の世界に生きる私たちが<CR>“今”の延長線上にあるのは間違いない
records.en_original: But I have no doubt that the people we will be in the next world will be an extension of who we are now...
records.en_auxiliary: But I have no doubt that the people we will be in the next world will be an extension of who we are now...
records.en: But there's no doubt that the people we become in the next world<CR>will be a continuation of who we are now.

records.jp: だから、もし記憶がなくなっても、<CR>すべてが無駄になるわけじゃない
records.en_original: So even if we lose our memories, everything will not have been in vain.
records.en_auxiliary: So even if we lose our memories, everything will not have been in vain.
records.en: So even if we lose our memories,<CR>none of it will have been wasted.

records.jp: 私も、みんなも……きっと、愛央もね
records.en_original: For me, for the others, and for you too, Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: For me, for the others, and for you too, Ao...
records.en: That goes for me, everyone...and surely you too, Ao.

records.jp: 美弦さんは、どうなりたい？<CR>新しい世界で、どういう自分になりたい？
records.en_original: What about you, Mio? Who do you want to become in the next world?
records.en_auxiliary: What about you, Mio? Who do you want to become in the next world?
records.en: What about you, Mio-san?<CR>Who do you want to become in the new world?

records.jp: 私？　私は……
records.en_original: Me? I...
records.en_auxiliary: Me? I...
records.en: Me? I...

records.jp: 陽桜莉が誇れる姉でいたい
records.en_original: I want to be a sister that Hiori can be proud of.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be a sister that Hiori can be proud of.
records.en: I want to remain an older sister Hiori can be proud of.

records.jp: 陽桜莉が楽しく過ごせるように支えてあげられる……<CR>そんな姉になりたい
records.en_original: I want to be the kind of sister that can support Hiori and help her enjoy herself...
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be the kind of sister that can support Hiori and help her enjoy herself...
records.en: I want to become an older sister who can support Hiori<CR>and help her live happily.

records.jp: ふふっ、妹想いだね～
records.en_original: Hehe, what a loving sister...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, what a loving sister...
records.en: Hehe, you really love your younger sister.

records.jp: い、いいでしょ。別に……
records.en_original: Wh-what's wrong with that...?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what's wrong with that...?
records.en: Wh-what's wrong with that...?

records.jp: うん、いいと思うよ
records.en_original: Nothing, I think it's great.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing, I think it's great.
records.en: No, I think that's wonderful.

records.jp: ……ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.

records.jp: こうして未来のことを考えられるのは、<CR>あなたのおかげね
records.en_original: It's all thanks to you that we can even imagine a future like this.
records.en_auxiliary: It's all thanks to you that we can even imagine a future like this.
records.en: It's thanks to you<CR>that we can think about the future like this.

records.jp: そんな、大げさだよ
records.en_original: I wouldn't go that far.
records.en_auxiliary: I wouldn't go that far.
records.en: I wouldn't go that far.

records.jp: いいえ、そんなことないわ。<CR>あなたがいてくれて、そして……
records.en_original: It's true. It's because you were here with us... And...
records.en_auxiliary: It's true. It's because you were here with us... And...
records.en: No, it isn't an exaggeration.<CR>Because you were here with us, and...

records.jp: 愛央。新しい世界でも、絶対に会いましょう
records.en_original: Ao, let's definitely meet again in the new world.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, let's definitely meet again in the new world.
records.en: Ao. Let's be sure to meet again in the new world.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 愛央に会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Ao.
records.en: I want to see you, Ao.

records.jp: 私は、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
